buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) – Point-wise 1. Submission of Documents with Technical Bid The bidder shall upload all required documents along with the Technical Bid

, duly signed and stamped with the company seal. The documents shall include: Technical Specifications Scope of Work (SOW) Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) Vendor Qualification Criteria (VQC) GeM Bid Document, including the Checklist and Additional Terms & Co nditions (ATC), wherever applicable. Any other document forming part of the bid. Submission of all required documents is mandatory for technical evaluation. Failure to submit any required document may result in rejection of the bid. 2. Bank Guarantee The successful bidder shall submit the required Bank Guarantee within 30 d ays from the date of placement of the Purchase Order. Failure to submit the Bank Guarantee within the stipulated period may resu lt in cancellation of the contract. 3. Authorized Source Requirement Quotations shall be accepted only from M/s Real Time Quality Management Services, Hyderabad. Quotations received from any other firm shall be treated as non-responsive and rejected. 4. Delivery Schedule Deliveries shall be made only on working days, Monday to Friday, between 09:30 AM and 04:30 PM. Prior coordination before delivery is mandatory. Contact numbers for delivery coordination: 040-24583248 040-24583296 5. Timely Delivery The successful bidder shall commence supply/fabrication/Job work immedia tely upon receipt of the GeM Supply Order. The work shall be completed within the agreed delivery schedule. Deliveries at or near the last permissible date should be avoided, as they m ay lead to rejection of supplies and adversely affect the seller's performanc e rating. 6. Documents to Accompany the Supply The following documents shall accompany each delivery, wherever applicabl e: Copy of the Contract/Purchase Order

Copy of the approved Delivery Period (DP) amendment, if applicable Tax Invoice/GeM Invoice Warranty Certificate (if applicable) Certificate of Conformance/Compliance (if applicable) Calibration Certificate (if applicable) Any other document specified in the contract 7. Bid Security Declaration (BSD) The bidder shall submit the Bid Security Declaration (BSD) Form along with the bid, wherever applicable. Failure to submit the BSD Form may result in rejection of the bid. 8. Inspection The supplied items/fabrication work shall be inspected by R&QA, DRDL after delivery and before acceptance. 9. Delivery Period The successful bidder shall complete the supply of the items and/or fabrication work within Three (9 ) months from the date of placement of the GeM Supply Or der 10. Jurisdiction Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the contract shall be subjec t to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Hyderabad. 11. Lot-wise Delivery The successful bidder shall deliver the items or complete the fabrication wo rk in three (3) lots, as per the delivery schedule agreed upon with the purch aser. 12. Payment Terms The bidder shall raise separate invoices for each delivery lot. Payment shall be processed by the DRDL Payment Authority on a lot-wise b asis. Payment shall be made after successful delivery, inspection, acceptance of the respective lot, and submission of all required documents, in accordance with the GeM contract terms. The payment shall be made in three instalments once in three months or on completion of milestones upo n submission of job completion certificate by the user and as per PRC recommendation. . 7.
